rules.name: npm package downloads
rules.description: Query npm configuration to find its active cache, including custom locations.
rules.impact: Permanent download-cache removal; installed dependencies remain. Packages download again.

rules.name: Unused uv package cache
rules.description: Query uv cache dir; use uv locking and pruning.
rules.impact: Unused packages pruned; measured size is not promised recovery.

rules.name: pip downloads
rules.description: Query python3 -m pip cache dir for the active interpreter.
rules.impact: Permanent wheel/download removal, not installed packages.

rules.name: Go build cache
rules.description: Query go env GOCACHE; Go owns the cache structure.
rules.impact: Build objects removed; next compilation takes longer.

rules.name: Homebrew downloads
rules.description: Discover cached bottles; review brew cleanup dry-run separately.
rules.impact: Homebrew cleanup may also remove old installed versions.

rules.name: Bun downloads
rules.description: Discover Bun's cache; verify installed-version command and project context.
rules.impact: Shared packages can be needed by active installs.

rules.name: Yarn cache
rules.description: Discover version-dependent caches; zero-install caches can be tracked.
rules.impact: Verify repository and Yarn version before cleanup.

rules.name: pnpm store
rules.description: Find the shared store; use verified pnpm store prune outside this adapter.
rules.impact: Shared package store, not a generic deletable folder.

rules.name: Node build headers
rules.description: Versioned headers for Node native-module builds.
rules.impact: Move selected cache to Trash; headers download again. Close build tools.

rules.name: Python test cache
rules.description: Require a project manifest; check Git tracking and nested repositories.
rules.impact: Only test run cache; not tests or source. Close test runners.

rules.name: Python analysis caches
rules.description: Require manifest and untracked generated directory.
rules.impact: Analysis runs rebuild cache; source/configuration excluded.

rules.name: Project Node dependencies
rules.description: Require project/lockfile inspection; local edits, links and unpublished packages matter.
rules.impact: Old does not mean reproducible. No blanket dependency deletion.

rules.name: Rust compiled artifacts
rules.description: Require Cargo manifest and distinguish configured target directory.
rules.impact: Use project-specific cargo clean after review.

rules.name: Project Python environments
rules.description: Find pyvenv.cfg; inspect locked dependencies and editable installs.
rules.impact: Can contain unique packages or edits. Inspection only.

rules.name: Downloaded installers
rules.description: Find old installer files; the user decides whether they are needed.
rules.impact: Personal download, not automatic disposal. Selected file goes to Trash.

rules.name: Downloaded archives
rules.description: Discover old archives; extraction/redundancy must be established separately.
rules.impact: May be the only copy. Age alone is insufficient.

rules.name: Chromium browser cache
rules.description: Match exact cache children; close browser before cleanup.
rules.impact: Cache redownloads; cookies/history/passwords/profile root are excluded.

rules.name: Browser compiled code cache
rules.description: Chromium JavaScript compilation cache, separate from site databases.
rules.impact: Close browser; code recompiles on next use.

rules.name: App caches to inspect
rules.description: Identify owning app; names/bundle IDs are fuzzy attribution evidence.
rules.impact: Some caches hold offline content. Unknown apps remain inspection-only.

rules.name: Sandboxed app caches
rules.description: Inspect individual cache children; never delete whole containers.
rules.impact: Shared/offline content requires owning-app verification.

rules.name: Old app logs
rules.description: Inspect rotated logs, age and current writers.
rules.impact: Diagnostic value may be lost; active logs must not be truncated.

rules.name: Crash reports
rules.description: Find old reports; retain needed troubleshooting evidence.
rules.impact: Reports can be valuable for unresolved issues.

rules.name: Messaging app caches
rules.description: Match cache only, not message databases or attachments.
rules.impact: Close app first; cached resources download again.

rules.name: Cloud offline copies
rules.description: Inspect without reading/downloading placeholder contents.
rules.impact: Use provider online-only controls. Generic deletion removes synced originals.

rules.name: Offline music, podcasts and TV
rules.description: Inspect size/owner; use app remove-download interfaces.
rules.impact: Libraries and original recordings are not disposable by extension.

rules.name: Device backups
rules.description: Identify recovery coverage; use Finder Manage Backups.
rules.impact: Recovery history must be selected deliberately in its owning app.

rules.name: Editor resource caches
rules.description: Exact resource-cache children, not sessions/workspaces/extensions.
rules.impact: Close editor; resources are rebuilt/downloaded.

rules.name: Editor compiled caches
rules.description: Compiled Electron/V8 data in recognized editor app paths.
rules.impact: Next launch may take longer; close editor before cleanup.

rules.name: Electron downloads
rules.description: Downloaded framework binaries; exclude active builds.
rules.impact: Can download again; moving to Trash does not reclaim space immediately.

rules.name: Next.js build caches
rules.description: Require project marker and untracked files; exclude active dev servers.
rules.impact: Cache rebuild, not project source or deployment configuration.

rules.name: Vite dependency cache
rules.description: Discover optimizer cache within dependencies; Vite can regenerate with --force.
rules.impact: Nested dependency roots are not traversed generically.

rules.name: Automation browsers
rules.description: Identify installed browser versions and active automation.
rules.impact: Tests need browser reinstalls. Use owning-tool supported cleanup.

rules.name: Agent scratch work
rules.description: Inspect tool ownership and live sessions; exclude transcripts/credentials.
rules.impact: Tool-specific evidence required; sessions are not generic cache.

rules.name: Existing local model downloads
rules.description: Find existing downloads only; this app installs no local AI models.
rules.impact: Preserve fine-tunes and active models; use vendor cache management.

rules.name: Docker images and build data
rules.description: Report disk image size; use Docker's own inventory/prune controls.
rules.impact: Volumes may contain unique databases; never delete the virtual disk generically.

rules.name: Generated site output
rules.description: Confirm output path in build configuration and preserve public/source assets.
rules.impact: A generic dist/build name can hold unique files.

rules.name: Final Cut render files
rules.description: Use Final Cut Delete Generated Library Files; do not traverse library internals.
rules.impact: Rendering repeats; preserve original clips and project/library databases.

rules.name: Proxy media
rules.description: Verify originals remain online and use editor-generated media management.
rules.impact: Proxy regeneration can take hours; names alone are insufficient.

rules.name: Optimized video media
rules.description: Verify original media and editor-managed regenerated copies.
rules.impact: Large transcodes can be expensive to recreate.

rules.name: Adobe media cache
rules.description: Use Premiere media-cache controls; custom paths need app configuration evidence.
rules.impact: Audio conforming/previews recreate; close Adobe tools.

rules.name: After Effects disk cache
rules.description: Use app preferences to confirm disk cache path and purge.
rules.impact: Preview frames rerender; do not remove project/autosave files.

rules.name: Resolve render cache
rules.description: Confirm Resolve cache location; use Delete Render Cache controls.
rules.impact: Preserve databases, originals and optimized media needed offline.

rules.name: Lightroom previews
rules.description: Distinguish previews from catalogs/originals; use Lightroom settings.
rules.impact: Smart previews may be the only offline editing copy.

rules.name: Photo app thumbnail caches
rules.description: Known app locations are leads; verify cache-only contents before deletion.
rules.impact: Preserve photo libraries, catalogs and originals.

rules.name: Audio waveform analysis
rules.description: Find known waveform extensions; verify corresponding originals and app rules.
rules.impact: Extension alone is not deletion authority; analysis recreates only with originals.

rules.name: Old exports to review
rules.description: Confirm project and all source assets can reproduce the exact export.
rules.impact: Exports may be the only delivered/master copy.

rules.name: iMovie generated media
rules.description: Locate library only; use iMovie Delete Render Files settings.
rules.impact: Never delete the whole library; originals/projects remain valuable.

rules.name: Xcode DerivedData
rules.description: Generated build products and indexes; inspect active builds before removal.
rules.impact: Rebuild and reindex on next use; archives and source are excluded.

rules.name: Simulator runtimes
rules.description: Read simctl runtime metadata and mounted volume usage; remove only validated runtime UUIDs.
rules.impact: Runtime must be reinstalled for its simulator devices. Mounted size differs from reclaimable image size.

rules.name: Xcode release archives
rules.description: Release archives and symbols; review in Organizer.
rules.impact: Archives may be needed for distribution and crash symbolication.

rules.name: Xcode device support
rules.description: Version-specific debugging support; retain versions in use.
rules.impact: May require re-download or reconnecting old devices.

rules.name: Simulator caches
rules.description: Discover generated caches separately from devices and runtime images.
rules.impact: Use supported simulator management; preserve device data.

rules.name: Cypress cache
rules.description: Installed test runner binaries; close Cypress before cleanup.
rules.impact: Test binaries must be downloaded again.

rules.name: Cargo registry cache
rules.description: Shared package sources, indexes and archives.
rules.impact: Preserve unpublished/local edits; rebuild needs registry access.

rules.name: Cargo Git dependencies
rules.description: Dependency checkouts may contain local modifications.
rules.impact: Inspect checkouts before supported tool cleanup.

rules.name: Gradle caches
rules.description: Shared build/download caches; coordinate running daemons.
rules.impact: Builds redownload dependencies and distributions.

rules.name: Maven repository
rules.description: Downloaded dependencies can be mixed with unpublished artifacts.
rules.impact: Local-only packages may not be reproducible.

rules.name: Dart package cache
rules.description: Use Dart pub cache controls; inspect globally activated tools.
rules.impact: Packages and tools need reinstalling.

rules.name: NuGet package cache
rules.description: Use dotnet nuget locals controls after build activity checks.
rules.impact: Packages must be restored, including private feeds.

rules.name: Ruby gem downloads
rules.description: Downloaded archives, separate from installed gems and project vendor data.
rules.impact: Use RubyGems/Bundler cleanup appropriate to the environment.

rules.name: Composer download cache
rules.description: Shared PHP package downloads, not project vendor source.
rules.impact: Use composer clear-cache; packages download again.

rules.name: Conda package downloads
rules.description: Use conda clean dry-run; environment links may depend on package storage.
rules.impact: Do not delete environments or shared hardlinks generically.

rules.name: SwiftPM downloads
rules.description: Dependency archives/checkouts; preserve configurations and credentials.
rules.impact: Resolve dependencies again through supported SwiftPM commands.

rules.name: Swift build output
rules.description: Find package-generated build directories with manifests.
rules.impact: Use swift package clean; verify no user edits.

rules.name: Python environment tool caches
rules.description: Separate package caches from managed environments.
rules.impact: Use owning-tool cache controls and preserve editable installs.

rules.name: Python bytecode caches
rules.description: Bytecode is generated, but source/track-state must be checked.
rules.impact: Python regenerates bytecode when source is available.

rules.name: Notebook checkpoints
rules.description: Checkpoints are recovery copies; confirm current notebooks are saved.
rules.impact: Do not discard the only recovery version.

rules.name: JavaScript lint caches
rules.description: Generated lint results; verify project and Git state.
rules.impact: Lint checks rerun.

rules.name: Turborepo task cache
rules.description: Cached task artifacts in confirmed projects.
rules.impact: Build tasks rerun; preserve source and configuration.

rules.name: Parcel caches
rules.description: Generated bundler cache within project scope.
rules.impact: Parcel rebuilds the cache.

rules.name: Webpack generated cache
rules.description: Build cache, separate from project packages.
rules.impact: Close builds and verify cache configuration.

rules.name: Component preview output
rules.description: Confirm generated static output and reproducible build.
rules.impact: May be a delivered artifact; user must confirm retention.

rules.name: Android project build output
rules.description: Project Gradle state, separate from SDK and source.
rules.impact: Use project clean tasks and close active builds.

rules.name: Android emulator data
rules.description: Device images may contain test data and app state.
rules.impact: Use Device Manager; no generic image deletion.

rules.name: Unity import caches
rules.description: Generated asset imports; verify editor and project originals.
rules.impact: Reimport may be expensive; preserve assets.

rules.name: Unreal derived data
rules.description: Shader and generated asset caches, possibly custom configured.
rules.impact: Recompilation can be lengthy; use editor-supported controls.

rules.name: Godot generated imports
rules.description: Require project.godot and intact source assets.
rules.impact: Godot reimports assets; project settings remain valuable.

rules.name: Blender temporary render data
rules.description: Custom caches need project/asset evidence; avoid autosave originals.
rules.impact: Render/simulation work may need recomputing.

rules.name: Houdini generated caches
rules.description: Simulation outputs can be expensive and project-specific.
rules.impact: Preserve project originals and confirmed cache dependencies.

rules.name: Photoshop caches
rules.description: Scratch disks and recovery data require app-specific management.
rules.impact: Do not remove open document recovery data.

rules.name: Adobe Bridge previews
rules.description: Use Bridge purge-cache controls for generated previews.
rules.impact: Thumbnails/previews rebuild; originals are excluded.

rules.name: Affinity app caches
rules.description: Verify owning app and distinguish recovery documents.
rules.impact: Preserve originals and recovery data.

rules.name: Figma resource cache
rules.description: Exact Electron cache children, not entire Figma user data.
rules.impact: Close Figma; resources rebuild/download.

rules.name: Zoom caches
rules.description: Cache-only scope; downloaded recordings are separate originals.
rules.impact: Use owning-app controls; preserve meeting recordings.

rules.name: Microsoft Teams caches
rules.description: Versions differ; inspect exact resource caches and shared containers.
rules.impact: Preserve user sessions and offline files.

rules.name: Telegram cached media
rules.description: Use Telegram storage controls; local-only content must be retained.
rules.impact: Media may need redownloading; not all message data is disposable.

rules.name: WhatsApp local storage
rules.description: App version/container dependent; preserve message databases and originals.
rules.impact: Use app-supported storage management.

rules.name: Spotify cache
rules.description: Distinguish cache from intentional offline music downloads.
rules.impact: Offline availability may be lost; use storage settings.

rules.name: Firefox cache
rules.description: Only cache2; preserve profiles, bookmarks, passwords and databases.
rules.impact: Close Firefox; web cache downloads again.

rules.name: Safari cache locations
rules.description: Protected/version-specific caches; use Safari supported controls.
rules.impact: Do not clear history, passwords or site data as generic cache.

rules.name: Embedded browser caches
rules.description: Web app storage can contain offline documents and sessions.
rules.impact: Owning-app verification required; not blanket disposable.

rules.name: Google app data
rules.description: Measure the whole app-data root while identifying caches separately.
rules.impact: Profiles, credentials, offline data and originals may be mixed. Do not delete the root.

rules.name: Recording app data
rules.description: Recording projects and media may coexist with previews/caches.
rules.impact: Recordings may be personal originals; preserve until explicitly reviewed in the owning app.

rules.name: Other app data
rules.description: Discover large app-owned children generically; do not assume roots contain only caches.
rules.impact: May contain databases, projects, recordings or credentials. Inspection only.

rules.name: Trash to review
rules.description: Measure recovery staging; users review/empty Trash in Finder.
rules.impact: Emptying Trash removes recovery options permanently.

rules.name: Shared system logs
rules.description: Shared diagnostics are read-only; use macOS-supported maintenance.
rules.impact: System-owned logs are not generic deletion targets.

rules.name: Device software downloads
rules.description: Old firmware installers; check device restore needs.
rules.impact: Future restore may require downloading firmware again.

rules.name: Older Downloads
rules.description: Age-based inspection, not proof of redundancy.
rules.impact: May contain originals and the only copy of important files.

rules.name: Mail attachments
rules.description: Use app storage controls and preserve personal originals.
rules.impact: Attachments can be unique; databases must remain consistent.

rules.name: Desktop installers
rules.description: Used installers in Desktop; user selects exact files.
rules.impact: Download again if needed; selected files go to Trash.
